neighbours.label: the noun after 'one of the most' + adjective ('one of the most influential novels')
fire: This remains one of the most controversial films in history.
He was one of the most gifted painters of his age.
It is one of the most popular games in Brazil.
She wrote one of the most important essays of the decade.
Lagos is one of the most crowded cities in Africa.
That was one of the most difficult choices of my life.
It became one of the most widely read books in France.
They are among the most respected scientists in Japan.
quiet: This remains a very controversial film in history.
He was a very gifted painter of his age.
It is a very popular game in Brazil.
She wrote a very important essay of the decade.
Lagos is a very crowded city in Africa.
That was a very difficult choice of my life.
It became a very widely read book in France.
They are very respected scientists in Japan.

short: noun in 'one of the most ADJ N'
notes: Probes also fired on ' confidence' in 'gives lenders the confidence to' (0.67) and ' choices' in 'about the choices we have' (0.60), which this label does not cover. ' confidence' in other frames stayed at 0.00.
